mapper.select: select (select count(1) from t_sale_order where status = 0 and is_deleted = 0) as draftOrders, (select count(1) from t_sale_order where status = 1 and is_deleted = 0 and delivery_date = #{tomorrow}) as pendingPurchase, (select count(1) from t_delivery_order where status = 0 and is_deleted = 0) as pendingPrint, (select count(1) from t_delivery_order d where d.status = 2 and d.is_deleted = 0 and not exists (select 1 from acceptance a where a.delivery_order_id = d.id)) as pendingAcceptance, (select count(1) from order_adjustment) as pendingAdjust
